lastCompletedStory.title: cam stats tokens command + dispatch wiring

nextStoryContext: `cam stats tokens` is wired end-to-end: COMMANDS/HELP_REGISTRY gained a 'stats' entry (index.ts, alphabetically slotted after 'status', before 'orch-budget' -- test/commands-freeze.test.ts FROZEN_COMMANDS/count was bumped to 28 in the same commit, this is the expected update path any future COMMANDS addition must repeat). index.ts wiring (parseStatsArgs/dispatchStats, mirroring the parsePatternsArgs/dispatchPatterns single-subcommand shape) is thin: all business logic (reading .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl, calling aggregateTokensPerIssue from US-001's src/stats/tokens.ts, rendering the per-issue table, the unattributed-spend flag, the orch-vs-output-tokens formula-asymmetry note, and the CAM_STATS_TOKENS=issues=<N> mean=<M> median=<Md> unattributed=<U> sentinel line) lives in src/commands/stats.ts's runStatsTokens, mirroring orch-budget.ts's injectable cwd/readEventLog/write shape -- always exits 0. US-003/US-004 (split-advisory heuristic + plan-time emission) are a separate subsystem (plan-split-advisory event kind) and do not depend on the stats command; no direct coupling expected, but both read/write the same event log file so keep the JSONL line-shape conventions (kind/detail, tolerant-parse-skip-malformed) consistent if either touches src/commands/journal.ts or src/supervisor/events.ts.
